QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_2

question.text: Saraswati Absolute Return Fund is a Category III AIF investing in listed equity derivatives. What is the conventional base for calculating management fees for a Category III AIF?

answer.text: Gross Net Asset Value (GNAV) computed periodically
Subscription price of units at launch

explanation.text: The Logic: Category III AIFs charge management fees at 1% to 2.5% of Gross NAV (GNAV), paid periodically when GNAV is computed. GNAV is computed before management fees and incentive fees and after netting outside liabilities. The Trap: Option A is the Category I/II commitment-based fee basis. Option C is closer to a PE-style invested-capital convention. Option D incorrectly freezes the base at launch. Note: GNAV is the conventional fee base for Category III AIFs per the workbook's fee chapter.
